entry.title: JE-8086 1.0.0
entry.summary: # JE-8086 1.0.0 Rebuilt on the MPC Plugin SDK, with a new native skin. ## New - **New skin** in the JP-8000's look: one LCD on MAIN instead of many small readouts, big knobs, long faders, rubber keys with LEDs. Pages: MAIN, BANKS, OSC, FILTER / AMP, ENVELOPES, EFFECTS, PERFORM, CONTROL, VELOCITY. - **Envelope graphs** on the ENVELOPES page: drag the handles, or use the faders under them. - **Name your favourites:** +FAV opens an on-screen keyboard; the name shows in MPC's PRESET menu. - **RANDOM

entry.title: JE-8086 0.1.1
entry.summary: JE-8086 for MPC 0.1.1: a Roland JP-8000 emulation (gearmulator) for MPC Gen2 devices (MPC Live III and other aarch64 MPCs) on MPC OS 3.10 or later. Changes since 0.1.0: - The emulator now runs on the fast cores of big.LITTLE CPUs.
